headline: Gold Falls 0.65% to $3,922 as US Yields Rise
summary: Gold fell 0.65% to $3,922 an ounce as US yields rose to 4.93% and the dollar strengthened.
why: Gold is often held as an inflation hedge and safe-haven asset, and its price typically moves inversely to US Treasury yields and the US dollar.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: The input explicitly reports a 0.65% drop in the price of gold to $3,922.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Higher US Treasury yields raise the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding precious metals, while a firmer dollar weighs on commodity prices denominated in USD.
